Alia: Heads-up — creating a release candidate for the route-cache work. Calling this one 'origami' so we don't confuse with other RCs. Need quick sign-offs for docs, perf, and rollback plan before I hit promote. @Sam @Maria @Jordan please ack.

deploy-bot: build 2026.03.1-rc.origami finished · artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/2026.03.1-rc.origami.tar.gz · sha256: 3f9a...ea12

Sam: ran a staging soak at 1k rps for 30m. p50/p95/p99 all within expected delta. saw a memory bump at ~80% load, probably kv cache warmup. not blocking but note for ops. attaching brief logs.

Maria: docs draft live: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026.03.1-origami — called out tokenizer change + KV semantics. still adding migration snippet for older SDKs.

Jordan: ops checklist updated. plan to pin image tag in deploy: `redwood/inference:2026.03.1-rc.origami`. rollback image set to `redwood/inference:2026.02.9-stable`. will add DB migration rollback steps to runbook. recommend quiet window 10m after 100% shift.

Alia: canary plan proposal: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> 100% for 15m. auto-rollback triggers: >3% error rate delta OR p99 increases >200ms OR kv hitrate < 70%. who is sheriff for the window?

ops-sheriff: I can sheriff 14:00-15:00 UTC. will watch dashboards and paging. set my alerts to critical-only for the promo.

Maria: adding a short migration snippet: `client.set_tokenizer_version('v2')` and note about backward-compat. will push last edit in 20m.

Sam: add telemetry checks: tokens/sec/request baseline + kv hit rate. if kv hits drop below 70% for 5m, rollback. also sanity check: latency tail on embeddings route.

Alia: I've updated the release notes with the migration callout and a short rollback playbook. Quick approvals?

Sam: perf ack :white_check_mark:

Maria: docs ack :white_check_mark:

Jordan: ops ack — pinned images and runbook entries added :white_check_mark:

Alia: good. scheduling promote via deploy-bot. If no objections in 10, we'll confirm.

deploy-bot: /schedule promote build=2026.03.1-rc.origami window=2026-03-15T14:00Z canary=10,50,100 quiet=600 notify=@ops-sheriff auto_rollback_on=error_rate,p99,kv_hitrate

Alia: approving the schedule. thanks all — will be in the channel during the window. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled. Reminder will post 10 minutes before window. Good luck! :rocket:
